name: Ms. Maid
source:
A graduate of the famous 冥土 academy which trains girls with potential to serve under socially important members of demon society. To distinguish themselves from regular serving maids, all graduates refer to themselves with the name of the academy when searching for potential employers.

One graduate sent a questionnaire to the Flame Tree castle looking for potential employers. Fabio returned the questionnaire and the letter of recommendation (half in jest) but he was immediately identified by the playable Maid as her suitable employer for life. Under the assessment criteria of intelligence, wealth and martial prowess, Fabio meets the first condition and should meet the second benchmark provided he succeeds in elevating Primtine to the throne. It is the third condition that triggers an attack by the Maid contingent as they seek to find out for themselves if Fabio meets the required standard (all of them are trained in the arts of battle).

[Spoiler] After Maid is captured, she makes an immediate offer to work under Fabio as he has satisfied all three of her basic conditions for employment. For the final test, she tests him on his sexual prowess which he passes with some difficulty.

Prior to her acceptance in the academy, she was a street child who lived rough and survived by her wits. It took centuries for her to acquire the skillset demanded by the academy, but she can still display the language and demeanour of a street ruffian when required.

A closet masochist, she goes as far as deliberately breaking vases in Fabio's vicinity in hope she is punished in a sexual manner for her misdemeanour. It takes Fabio a while to work out this unusual ploy, especially as the vases are not the property of Primtine and are bought by Maid at her personal expense.

In her end, she does not leave Fabio's side and continues to clean the castle and assist Fabio in his tasks. Her habit of "accidentally" breaking vases in Fabio's presence remains unchanged. [/spoiler]
